2026-10-11 08:27:49.265150 | controller |
2026-10-11 08:27:49.265154 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-11 08:27:49.265157 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-11 08:27:49.265160 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-11 08:27:49.265164 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-11 08:27:49.265167 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-11 08:27:49.265170 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
